evidence.name: Screen field: Choose where the answer is saved
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Choose where the answer is saved" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Choose where the answer is saved
sections.description: Pick which variable stores this screen's answer, or create a new one on the spot. Reuse an existing variable when this screen asks about the same thing as another screen (so all answers feed one value), and create a new one for a brand-new question. This is the key step: nothing downstream (branching, analytics, paywall personalization) works until a variable is chosen here.
